Don't forget that this is 360 video: you can change the angle of view. 

Easter Island is one of the most mysterious places on Earth. This small volcanic island is located in the southeastern Pacific Ocean and belongs to Chile. Locals call it Rapa Nui. Despite its remoteness from the mainland, the island is known worldwide for its moai stone statues.
